title: RabMV: Registry-Aware Boosting Machine of Valledupar
description: An explainable boosting machine that knows the structure of the public-health registry its data come from: which concepts each surveillance form measures, in which version and how comparably. It audits undeclared differential measurement between forms, admits a concept only when both classes measured it comparably, and marginalizes what a form did not measure, with purified pairwise interactions. Includes two frozen ADEMP simulations and a public synthetic registry.
